notes.title: Permanently Reduced Price
notes.content: [h2][b]Price Adjustment[/b][/h2][p]To unify pricing across platforms where [i]Ad SHOOt[/i] is or will be available, we have permanently reduced the regular price.[/p][p]We’ve also rebalanced pricing to reflect recent currency rate changes, ensuring fair access for players around the world.[/p][p]We deeply appreciate the early support from those who purchased shortly after release.[/p][p]Naturally, the game will be discounted even further during sales, so if you’re still waiting, be sure to add it to your wishlist and stay tuned for future promotions![/p][p][/p][h2][b]New Highlights[/b][/h2][p]Along with the price adjustment, we’ve updated the store page with more details.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Original Soundtrack[/b][/h3][p]All [b]7 stages[/b] and [b]7 bosses[/b] feature their own [b]exclusive tracks[/b], totaling [b]18 original tracks[/b] that bring the game to life.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]6 Variations in the Extra Stage[/b][/h3][p]In addition to the main 6 stages, there’s one Extra Stage.[/p][p]The Extra Stage offers [b]6 different options[/b], each with its own [b]pre/post-battle dialogue[/b] and [b]unique ending illustrations[/b].[/p][p]All dialogue is fully voiced in Japanese by [b]professional voice actors[/b], just like the main story—giving you new experiences each time you replay.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]No Real Ads[/b][/h3][p]Rest assured, there are [b]no real-world advertisements[/b] forcibly shown during gameplay.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Updated Screenshots[/b][/h3][p]The in-game screenshots have been updated to reflect adjustments made since release (the player character is now slightly smaller). We’ve also added one more image, bringing the total to [b]6 screenshots[/b].[/p][p][/p][h2][b]In Closing[/b][/h2][p][i]Ad SHOOt[/i] is now even more accessible—please give it a try![/p][p]We’d be very grateful if you could leave a Steam review![/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Please nominate us for the STEAM Awards 2024!
notes.content:
The [b]STEAM Awards 2024[/b] will be held.
"Ad SHOOt" is a classic 2D vertical scrolling shooter game, and its system and design follow those of existing works... You may be wondering "how is it innovative?" but we would like to hear your nominations in the [b]"Most Innovative Gameplay" category!

[h3]Innovative points[/h3]
[olist]
[*] A shooter game with character design and voice aimed at women
[*] The enemy's purpose is to advertise their own products
[*] The company the enemy belongs to is not an evil organization
[*] Buildings grow along with the Mansion Poem
[*] Fried in oil with Poteto and salted
[*] A boss that summons a real estate agent
[*] A mid-boss is an unmanned forklift
[*] Crushed by a rotary tablet press
[*] A toilet and sink symbol on a floor plan attacks
[*] A barrage of bullets that follow traffic signals
[*] A barrage of bullets where a pin from a map app is stuck into the earth
[*] A lot of no-shoot bonuses
[/olist]
As mentioned above, we offer gameplay that no one has ever experienced before! The recommendation period is from 11/27 (10:00) to 12/4 (10:00) during the "Steam Autumn Sale".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45064468/22930ad5294d4262a8dbb5570ec62d38b79fb659.png[/img]

[h3]About the sale[/h3]
This game was released on 11/4 and it has not been 30 days since then, so it cannot participate in the seasonal sale.
The retail price is  $12.99.

If you think "it is too expensive", please add it to your wishlist and wait for future sales!

*If you add it to your list, you will be notified when the sale starts. Also, you are not obligated to buy the games on your list.

notes.title: Increased Score Cap
notes.content:
【Score Cap】

Previously, the score cap was set at 999,999,999. It has now been updated as follows:

Steam Community Leaderboard: 2,147,483,647
In-Game Leaderboard: 99,999,999,999

The score cap of 2,147,483,647 represents the maximum positive integer value (int type) that the Steam ranking system can handle.


【High Score Recording Timing】

High scores will now only be recorded during the following moments if a new high score is achieved:

During the mid-dialogue after defeating the Stage 6 Boss.
During the mid-dialogue after defeating the EX Boss.

[hr][/hr]
Bug Fixes and Adjustments

【Unplayable Bug Fix】

Fixed an issue where skipping dialogue before the Stage 4 Boss battle by holding the button and releasing it during the final line prevented the boss battle from starting.


【Boss Durability Adjustments】

The Stage 4 Boss and the second phase of the Stage 6 mid-boss were too weak. We have adjusted their HP and the player's shot power accordingly.


【Confetti Randomization Adjustment】

Confetti during Stage 3's mid-section was biased towards the right side. This has been corrected to spread evenly across both sides.


【Item Spawn Fix】

Fixed an error where Graze items (green particles) were mistakenly spawning in place of Score items (light blue diamonds).


【Image Optimization】

Changed the image format for bullet patterns used by the initial attacks of the Stage 5 Boss and EX Boss from PNG to JPG to reduce file size.


【Graze Hitbox Enhancements】

Increased the number of enemies and bullets with Graze hitboxes.


【Volume Adjustment】

Decreased the title screen's background music volume by 10%.


【Easy Mode Interval Tweaks】

Adjusted certain patterns in Easy Mode where bullets took too long to start or had overly long shot intervals.


【How to Update】

If you open Steam for the first time that day:
In your Steam library, the usual green "Play" button for Ad SHOOt will turn into a blue "Update" button. Click it to proceed. You may also see "Installing" or "Downloading" as the update progresses automatically.

If your PC and Steam are already running:
Restart your PC, close Steam via Task Manager, or log out of your Steam account and log back in to refresh your library. The green "Play" button will then change to a blue "Update" button as described above.
Note: Clicking the "×" in the top-right corner of Steam does not fully close the application.

If you encounter any new issues or bugs after this update, please feel free to contact us via[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2954360/discussions/0/4516631714059071569/] the Bug/Issue Discussion Thread [/url] or our [url=https://form1ssl.fc2.com/form/?id=3faf3e1188892045] email form [/url](you may leave the handle name and email address fields blank).

notes.title: Fixed Bug Limiting Score Ranking Display to 3 Entries
notes.content:
[h3]Bug Summary[/h3]

Due to a configuration error with the Steam ranking, only up to three entries were being displayed out of all participant entries.

Score submission to Steam - Normal
Ranking update - Normal
Ranking retrieval and display - Error

Apologies to those who cleared the game and were left wondering, “Why isn’t my score displayed?” or “What rank did I get in the end?” We sincerely apologize for any confusion caused!

Click [url=#comrank]here[/url] to learn how to check your rank without replaying the full version.


[h3]Fix Results[/h3]

Full Version: All entries now display in-game across Easy to Extra modes and are also reflected in the community rankings.

Demo Version: All entries are now displayed in-game across Easy (Demo) to Hard (Demo) modes.


[h3]Ranking Scroll Functionality[/h3]

If there are many entries, a scrollbar will appear, allowing you to scroll through the rankings with the up and down arrow keys on your keyboard or the D-pad or left stick on your gamepad.

Although unintentional, scrolling also works with a mouse or pen tablet. It may also work with touch on supported devices.

[h3=comrank]How to Check Community Rankings[/h3]

[olist] 
[*] Open the full version of Ad SHOOt from the Steam client’s library. 
[*] Click any icon in the Achievements section. 
[*] In the top right, select the "Global Ranking" tab. 
[*] "Easy Ranking" will appear in the upper left, displaying the Easy mode rankings for the full version. 
[*] Select other difficulties from the top left tab, e.g., "Normal Ranking," and click the "Show" button next to it to view the selected ranking. 
[/olist]
*In-game confirmation of whether you’d like to participate in the rankings, showing your Steam username and icon, pertains to this community ranking display.

*Demo version rankings are only viewable in-game and are not displayed in the community.


[h3]Other Fixes[/h3]

In the Extra boss's second-to-last bullet pattern, grazing (near-miss) detection for enemy bullets was missing and has been added.

notes.title: Now Compatible with Steam Deck
notes.content:
The Steam Deck is a portable gaming PC device.

When playing Ad SHOOt on Steam Deck, the screen resolution is fixed at 1280 px × 720 px. You can select any screen size option in the in-game menu.

Here are the controls for playing Ad SHOOt on Steam Deck:

[h3]Menu Controls[/h3]
[list]
[*] Move to select items: Left D-pad or Left Stick
[*] Confirm/Proceed Dialogue: B (Right East Button)
[*] Fast-forward Dialogue: Hold B (Right East Button)
[*] Cancel: A (Right South Button)
[/list]
[h3]Player Controls[/h3]
[list]
[*] Move: Left D-pad or Left Stick
[*] Slow Movement & Focused Shot: Hold any of L1/L2/R1/R2 (L2 is recommended)
[*] Shot: Auto-fire while holding B (Right East Button)
[*] Bomb: Y (Right North Button)
[*] Pause: A (Right South Button)
[/list]

notes.title: August 19,2024 Demo Updated to Ver.0.0.3
notes.content:
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
Previously, when continuing after a game over, the player should have been revived with MAX shot power (including homing shots), but they were being revived one power level below MAX. This has been corrected to ensure revival with MAX power.

notes.title: August 3, 2024 - Demo Updated to Ver.0.0.2
notes.content:
[h3]Fixed Bugs[/h3]
[list]
[*]During Stage 3, the mid-boss's second phase "Caution: Pallet Incident" and the latter half Wave "Mail Delivery Person" occurred simultaneously
[*]In the final phase of Stage 2 boss "Explosion of Taste! Powerful Burger Bomb", when the giant hamburger bullet hits a wall and disappears, the player's character's lives decrease and cause the Unity Editor to freeze
[*]During the second phase of Stage 3 boss "Excessive Packaging", the size and position of the hitbox for the penalty bullets emitted when approaching the boss were incorrect, and the penalty area was not deployed at the beginning of the second phase
[/list]

[h3]Details of the Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]During Stage 3, the mid-boss's second phase "Caution: Pallet Incident" and the latter half Wave "Mail Delivery Person" occurred simultaneously
Cause: The mid-boss's phase time for Stage 3 was intended to be 30 seconds but was set to 60 seconds. Since the wave in the latter half starts 60 seconds after the mid-boss begins, the latter wave was starting during the mid-boss phase
Fix: Adjusted the duration of each phase of Stage 3 mid-boss to 30 seconds

[*]In the final phase of Stage 2 boss "Explosion of Taste! Powerful Burger Bomb", when the giant hamburger bullet hits a wall and disappears, the player's character's lives decrease and cause the Unity Editor to freeze
Cause: When the player's character loses a life, an explosion clears enemy bullets on screen, which inadvertently includes the giant hamburger disappearing, and at the same moment, the hamburger emits bullets in all directions upon hitting a wall and attempts to destroy its parent object, which had already disappeared
Fix: Modified the code to destroy the parent object only if it is not null

[*]During the second phase of Stage 3 boss "Excessive Packaging", the size and position of the hitbox for the penalty bullets emitted when approaching the boss were incorrect, and the penalty area was not deployed at the beginning of the second phase
Background: In "Excessive Packaging", entering the rotating cardboard box's inner side is considered a safe zone allowing quick attacks, thus a penalty area is placed inside, and when a player enters, the boss fires high-speed bullets in all directions as penalty
Cause: The reasons for the incorrect size are unclear. The boss's center position and the deployment location of the barrage might have shifted from expectations. The code to activate the penalty area at the start of "Excessive Packaging" was in place but failed to trigger. It only became active after the player was hit once
Fix: Adjusted the size and position of the penalty area appropriately. Added code to activate the penalty area in the individual control code for "Excessive Packaging". Added code to deactivate the penalty area at the start of the next "Redelivery has Arrived".
[/list]

notes.title: July 26, 2024 Updated Demo to Version 0.0.1
notes.content:
A mini-update was carried out to fix bugs.

[h3]Fixed Bugs[/h3]
[list]
[*] Inconsistent shot interval bug
[*] Key bindings reset upon restart bug
[*] Key bindings not reflected in the manual bug
[*]Unable to fire bombs independently from shots bug
[*]Overlapping enemy waves when the stage 3 mid-boss is defeated early bug
[/list]

[h3]Bug Causes and Solutions[/h3]
[list]
[*] Inconsistent shot interval bug
Cause: Normal shots and option shots shared the same timer, causing the 0.2-second interval of option shots and the 0.08-second interval of normal shots to mix.
Fix: Separated the intervals for normal shots and option shots, making normal shots and rear shots share the same interval.
Adjustment: Changed the interval to 0.1 seconds because the 0.08-second interval allowed for defeating enemies too quickly.

[*] Key bindings reset upon restart bug
Cause: Code that reset key bindings every time the settings screen was opened.
Fix: Removed the problematic code.
Result: Key bindings now persist after restarting the game.

[*] Key bindings not reflected in the title menu manual bug
Cause: Missing code and necessary variables to reflect key bindings in the manual when initializing settings.
Fix: Added reflection code after saving settings during initialization; included initial manual switching code in the title menu script.
Result: Key bindings reset to default are now reflected in the manual upon initialization, and the manual now displays the previous key bindings when the game is started.

[*]Unable to fire bombs independently from shots bug
Cause: The script for firing bombs was within the condition "while the shot button is pressed."
Fix: Moved the script for firing bombs to be independent of the shot button.
Result: Bombs can now be fired independently even when the shot button is not pressed.

[*]Overlapping enemy waves when the stage 3 mid-boss is defeated early bug
Cause: Enemies from Wave 1 continued to fire bullets even after Wave 2 had started.
Fix: Added code to clear all enemies and bullets on the screen before Wave 2 begins.
Result: The two waves no longer overlap.
[/list]

That's all for the update.
The change in shot interval may affect scores, but not significantly enough to alter high scores or rankings. The demo ranking will continue without resetting.

[h3]Update Method[/h3]
If your PC and Steam client are running, the update may not be applied. Also, pressing the ✖ icon in the upper right of the Steam client does not fully close Steam. To apply the update, open Task Manager with Ctrl+Alt+Delete, close Steam, and then restart it. The update will begin automatically.
